description: Research-preview remedy repertoire. Works out each graha's functional nature and afflictions, then returns conduct, optional charity, dosha candidates and Dasha-based timing. Mantras and gemstones require explicit opt-in and remain unreviewed traditional material. Lal Kitab remedies stay withheld until house-specific extraction, scan verification and independent review. No topic required.
